candidates.hypothesis: Entry-timing alpha: a fresh core long entry whose canonical next-open entry session falls inside the monthly options-expiration week (Monday through the third Friday) is admitted into pinning-suppressed, roll-flow-distorted tape and should be excluded for that session only, re-admitting on the first post-OPEX session; all non-OPEX sessions are untouched.

market_prior.provenance: The cash-feasible core ranking uses only frozen behavior inputs and OHLCV bars known by the signal close.

independent_evidence.provenance: Deterministic civil calendar; known arbitrarily far in advance; no external feed and no vintage ambiguity.
independent_evidence.state: The candidate entry session date falls between the Monday and the third Friday of its calendar month inclusive, per the deterministic civil-calendar rule.

expectation_gap.gap_definition: The existing price state says admit the core long entry, while the calendar says the surrounding week is dominated by expiry roll and dealer-hedging flow whose pinning suppresses continuation, so the breakout evidence is more likely mechanical and reverts after expiration.

transmission.catalyst: Post-expiration unwind of dealer hedges and roll flow removes the mechanical bid/pin that produced the entry trigger.
causal_steps: core price state admits a long candidate during the monthly expiration week
dealer gamma pinning and roll flow distort the trigger bar's information content
the OPEX-week entry is withheld for that session only
avoiding mechanically induced triggers improves replacement value over H10
transmission.expected_direction: exclude the core long entry only when its entry session falls inside the OPEX week

candidates.why_not_arbitraged: The claim is not that OPEX weeks are directionally down, but that trend/breakout triggers fired during expiry weeks are lower-quality for a 10-session hold; this interacts with the specific core entry contract and is invisible to generic seasonality screens.
candidates.falsifier: Fewer than five exact canonical baseline entry touches inside OPEX weeks in any standard window falsifies testability (outcome-blind); given density, failure to improve aggregate expected-value score without worse drawdown, or any window regression, falsifies the rule.

baseline.policy: Preserve the accepted core candidate order and admit entries on every session regardless of calendar position.

treatment.policy: Exclude a fresh core long entry when its canonical next-open entry session falls inside the Monday-to-third-Friday OPEX week; the signal may re-trigger and enter normally from the first post-OPEX session; no exit, sizing, or ranking changes.

candidates.replacement_value_comparator: Cash, SPY, QQQ, and the baseline entered trade under identical costs and capital constraints.

execution_envelope.capacity_constraint: same cash-feasible slot and notional limits as the active baseline
execution_envelope.costs_and_carry: canonical cash-equity costs and turnover accounting
execution_envelope.liquidity_dependency: the accepted core universe liquidity and spread floors
execution_envelope.timing_constraint: calendar membership known in advance; decision applies to the next-open entry session only

candidates.title: OPEX-week entry-timing de-admission for core trend entries

prediction.confidence_reason: Outcome-blind canonical baseline touch counts are 4 (old_thin), 2 (mid_weak), 3 (late_strong) OPEX-week entries versus the >=5 per-window floor, so the candidate is untestable on the frozen windows today; the mechanism also lacks a dealer-positioning proxy, which the exp-20260610-001 frozen family already named as the required reopen evidence.

candidates.reopen_condition: Reopen only when (a) rolling standard windows contain at least 5 canonical baseline entry touches inside OPEX weeks per window (recount with the frozen baseline artifact, one line, no experiment ID), or (b) a point-in-time options open-interest or dealer-gamma proxy surface exists per the exp-20260610-001 frozen-family reopen condition; threshold retunes and response-shape swaps without (a) or (b) stay closed.
candidates.next_machine_action: Record only: park this candidate as a falsified-at-density lead; recount OPEX-week baseline entry touches when a new standard window is frozen; do not reserve an experiment ID.
